details.effects: Assessment gives only represented color and supplied complete own evidence; unavailable/partial/unrelated food evidence remains limited. It grants no reward or safety finding. Read the retained conditional quote for source/model, dose, effort, response timing and stopping rules; quote is available because actual foundation apple physiology and exact tenths already exist, not because appearance establishes safety. Normal ageing/carrying is allowed; changed quantity, processing, owner, source/model or loss of surviving condition invalidates execution. Separate explicit one-shot ingestion conserves original10tenths=remaining9+swallowed1, updates actual satiety and health through existing v7FoodEffect, independent of mood; no hidden chemistry revealed in advance. Actual immediate personal before/after evidence stays private; one dose is not general safety or absence of delayed hazards. No delayed physiology exists and no safe waiting interval is invented. No preparation products, extra food, facility, passive work, locks or repeated charge. Before commit interruption/death charges nothing; after commit no refund even on cancellation/death. Existing meal substantial-intake rules prevent a tiny dose earning diversity bonuses. Only new actual verified response may invoke unchanged grounded-understanding; names/queries/mastery/assessment/repeats0. No historical package effects activated.
